methods.label: Count complete counter cycles and convert to miles
methods.explanation:
One complete counter cycle represents \(100{,}000\) steps: \(99{,}999\) steps reach \(99999\), and one more returns the display to \(00000\).

The \(44\) complete cycles, followed by the final reading of \(50{,}000\), give
\[
44\cdot100{,}000+50{,}000
=4{,}450{,}000
\]
steps. At \(1800\) steps per mile, Pete walked
\[
\frac{4{,}450{,}000}{1800}
\approx2472.2
\]
miles. This is below \(2500\), and every other listed choice is larger than \(2500\), so the closest choice is \(\boxed{2500}\) miles, choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
